title: A trial with a ready compute host keeps the benchmark tests on this machine and reports them passing
description: GY-3536: tests/hard-math-negative.test.ts imports the sandboxed benchmarks and stays local. A merge trial with a ready host runs it here, where it passes, while plain files still go to the host. Since GY-3549 tests importing the trial runner may run on a host.

steps.name: Run a trial with a ready compute host and the benchmark test file
